title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Ending Charge on a Fee Charged Again, by Recorded Cancellation Reason
content:
A re-charge ending charge is added to a fee charged again under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), which is the fee charged on a filing whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error. It follows how the backing term's coverage ended. That is read from the cancellation reason recorded on the backing Owner Auto Policy term or Named Non-Owner Policy term. A term that was cancelled and has since been reinstated keeps its recorded cancellation reason.

| Recorded cancellation reason of the backing term | Re-charge ending charge |
|---|---|
| nonpayment, underwriting or down payment dishonored, whether or not the term has since been reinstated | 4.00 |
| insured request | 2.00 |
| none recorded (the term was never cancelled) | none |

**Cases (hypothetical)**

- **Reinstated term.** An Owner Auto Policy term cancelled for nonpayment and since reinstated, now in force, still shows nonpayment as its recorded reason: 4.00.
- **Insured request.** An Owner Auto Policy term cancelled at the insured's request: 2.00.
- **Never cancelled.** A Named Non-Owner Policy term never cancelled, with no reason recorded: no ending charge.
